columns_never_fillable: properties.gla — trust discloses NLA and GFA per property, not GLA (page 68-69).
properties.major_tenants — only disclosed for the two master-leased assets (Xining, Dalian); multi-tenanted malls disclose portfolio-level top-10 tenants only (top_tenants.json), not per-property.
top_tenants.revenue_pct is by GRI (month of December 2024); no per-property tenant % disclosed.
data_with_no_home: Occupancy rate by property is disclosed both as committed occupancy (Occupancy Rate table, page 62) and matches per-property card figures.
WALE by NLA (5.1 yrs) and lease expiry profile by year are disclosed but the schema stores only the single primary WALE (by GRI, 3.0 yrs).
parsing_traps: Statement of Total Return (page 128) presents Group AND REIT columns side by side — all figures taken from the Group column. REIT-column 'Dividend income' 7,835 is intra-group and excluded.
'Net finance costs' 19,213 is a subtotal (finance income 91 - finance costs 19,304); line_items keep the gross components separately.
Beijing Wanliu is consolidated at 100% though 60% owned; do not scale to 60% — NCI captures the 40%.

flags.note: Trust holds 60% of Beijing Wanliu but consolidates it at 100% in the audited Portfolio Statement, Statement of Total Return, and Financial-Review tables. Non-controlling interests (7,262 total return; 166,362 balance) reflect the 40% third-party share.

'Valuation fee' is a credit (+44) in FY2024 (a write-back), shown as income-additive in the Statement of Total Return; carried as operating_expense_breakdown amount -44,000 and as a signed adjustment line +44,000.
